mapper.sql: select c.case_id, c.lead_id, l.display_name as lead_name, c.season, c.country, c.degree, c.program_id, c.school_name, c.program_name, c.result, c.scholarship, c.undergrad_tier, c.major_direction, c.gpa, c.ielts, c.test_scores, c.experience, c.verify_level, c.source, c.algo_consent, c.publicity_consent, c.consent_time, c.revoke_time, c.offer_file, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from abr_case c left join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = c.lead_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_case (lead_id, season, country, degree, program_id, school_name, program_name, result, scholarship, undergrad_tier, major_direction, gpa, ielts, test_scores, experience, verify_level, source, algo_consent, publicity_consent, consent_time, revoke_time, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{leadId}, #{season}, #{country}, #{degree}, #{programId}, #{schoolName}, #{programName}, #{result}, coalesce(#{scholarship}, ''), coalesce(#{undergradTier}, ''), coalesce(#{majorDirection}, ''), #{gpa}, #{ielts}, coalesce(#{testScores}, ''), coalesce(#{experience}, ''), #{verifyLevel}, #{source}, #{algoConsent}, #{publicityConsent}, #{consentTime}, #{revokeTime}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_case set lead_id = #{leadId}, season = #{season}, country = #{country}, degree = #{degree}, program_id = #{programId}, school_name = #{schoolName}, program_name = #{programName}, result = #{result}, scholarship = coalesce(#{scholarship}, ''), undergrad_tier = coalesce(#{undergradTier}, ''), major_direction = coalesce(#{majorDirection}, ''), gpa = #{gpa}, ielts = #{ielts}, test_scores = coalesce(#{testScores}, ''), experience = coalesce(#{experience}, ''), verify_level = #{verifyLevel}, source = #{source}, algo_consent = #{algoConsent}, publicity_consent = #{publicityConsent}, consent_time = #{consentTime}, revoke_time = #{revokeTime}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where case_id = #{caseId}
update abr_case set offer_file = coalesce(#{offerFile}, ''), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.delete: delete from abr_case where case_id in #{id}
